QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_58

question.text: What role do clearing banks play in commodity settlement?

answer.text: They effect debit and credit instructions for margin collection and settlement fund transfers between clearing members and the CC
They trade commodity futures on behalf of clients
They set the daily settlement prices

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the source workbook, clearing banks act on instructions from the clearing corporation to debit and credit clearing members' settlement accounts, facilitating fund transfers for margin collection and pay-in/pay-out between clearing members and the CC. Each clearing member maintains designated settlement and client accounts at the clearing bank. The Trap: Clearing banks do not trade commodity futures (that is the role of trading members), they do not set daily settlement prices (that is the exchange's role), and they do not own or operate warehouses (that is the role of warehouse service providers).
